summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Titles
summary.text: Astrological chapter titles on divination, genethliacal years, royal familiarization, bodily correspondences of the stars, conception, Indian methods, lots of education, paternity, fugitives, rains, and longevity. The list identifies the second book of Apomasar’s mysteries and names anet’ and apheret.
